ensemble_vote.label: Soft vote of 3 feature models
ensemble_vote.description: soft vote (mean log-prob) of spectral_lr, riemann_ts_lr, all_lgbm; each tuned by its own inner CV

nested_select.label: Nested model selection
nested_select.description: inner CV picks model family AND hyper-parameters among rbp_lr, spectral_lr, all_lr, riemann_ts_lr, all_lgbm

all_lr+age_sex.label: LR, all features + age, sex
all_lr+age_sex.description: all features (1213) + L2 logistic regression + age + sex (secondary)

all_rf.label: Random forest, all features
all_rf.description: all features + random forest (400 trees, min_samples_leaf=20, not tuned)

all_rbfsvm.label: RBF SVM, all features
all_rbfsvm.description: all features + RBF SVM (<=40 random epochs per training subject)

spectral_rbfsvm.label: RBF SVM, spectral features
spectral_rbfsvm.description: spectral features + RBF SVM (<=40 random epochs per training subject)

spectral_lr+age_sex.label: Spectral LR + age, sex
spectral_lr+age_sex.description: spectral features (399) + L2 logistic regression + age + sex (secondary)

riemann_ts_lr.label: Riemannian tangent-space LR
riemann_ts_lr.description: band-wise (5 bands + broadband) OAS covariances -> tangent space -> L2 LR

riemann_mdm.label: Riemannian MDM
riemann_mdm.description: band-wise covariances -> MDM (summed squared Riemannian distances)

labram_lr.label: LaBraM frozen + LR
labram_lr.description: frozen labram embedding (19 ch x 200, mean over 1-s patches) + L2 logistic regression (inner-CV C)

cbramod_lr.label: CBraMod frozen + LR
cbramod_lr.description: frozen cbramod embedding (19 ch x 200, mean over 1-s patches) + L2 logistic regression (inner-CV C)

cbramod_ft.label: CBraMod fine-tuned
cbramod_ft.description: CBraMod fine-tuned end to end (official weights, avg-pool head), 200 Hz

biot_lr.label: BIOT frozen + LR
biot_lr.description: EXPLORATORY: frozen BIOT (six-datasets weights) on 16 bipolar channels, 256-d mean token + L2 LR

shallow.label: ShallowFBCSPNet
shallow.description: ShallowFBCSPNet (braindecode defaults), 250 Hz, trained from scratch

eegnet.label: EEGNet
eegnet.description: EEGNet (braindecode defaults), 125 Hz, trained from scratch

cbramod_spectral_lr.label: CBraMod frozen + spectral + LR
cbramod_spectral_lr.description: hybrid: frozen CBraMod embedding (3800) + phase-1 spectral/aperiodic features (399) + L2 LR

ensemble_vote+cbramod_lr.label: Soft vote + CBraMod LR
ensemble_vote+cbramod_lr.description: soft vote (mean epoch log-prob) of spectral_lr, riemann_ts_lr, all_lgbm, cbramod_lr; each member tuned by its own inner CV; computed from the members' saved outer-fold predictions

ensemble_vote+shallow.label: Soft vote + ShallowFBCSPNet
ensemble_vote+shallow.description: soft vote (mean epoch log-prob) of spectral_lr, riemann_ts_lr, all_lgbm, shallow; each member tuned by its own inner CV; computed from the members' saved outer-fold predictions [POST HOC member choice]

ensemble_vote+labram_lr.label: Soft vote + LaBraM LR
ensemble_vote+labram_lr.description: soft vote (mean epoch log-prob) of spectral_lr, riemann_ts_lr, all_lgbm, labram_lr; each member tuned by its own inner CV; computed from the members' saved outer-fold predictions [POST HOC member choice]

ensemble_vote+cbramod_ft.label: Soft vote + CBraMod fine-tuned
ensemble_vote+cbramod_ft.description: soft vote (mean epoch log-prob) of spectral_lr, riemann_ts_lr, all_lgbm, cbramod_ft; each member tuned by its own inner CV; computed from the members' saved outer-fold predictions
